title.rendered: Oregon Department of Education Releases New 2021-22 Ready Schools, Safe Learners Guidance

content.rendered:
This afternoon, the Oregon Department of Education released the Ready Schools, Safe Learners Resiliency Framework for the 2021-22 School Year. The changes in this guidance align with the announcement this morning from Governor Kate Brown that Oregon will reopen no later than June 30 and that previous COVID-related executive orders will be lifted. 

In the coming weeks, our district leadership will be closely reviewing the newly-released guidance and engaging in conversations with our Board of Directors and school administrators about our plans for the coming school year. Please stay tuned for future communications with additional details about the 2021-22 school year as this work continues.
